subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: an hour ago

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four watchers in the corners

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: infiltration of the Water Temple
fact: The west door was breached by force after two failed attempts, leading to a successful bluff using false courier credentials.
source_quote: We would smash the door. Splash through it. Take them while their hands were still finding their weapons.

subject: Dagger of Venom value
fact: The Dagger of Venom is Kelno's gift, intended to kill Belsornig, and now wielded by Zephyr.
source_quote: the Dagger of Venom. Kelno's gift. *I've been saving this to kill Belsornig for some time.*

subject: Greater Temple entrance
fact: The Greater Temple's hidden forces occupy unseen areas of the Upper Temple, revealed by the arrival of black-clad bugbears.
source_quote: They came from the secret door we had left barred. They came from the eastern door. They came from the western door.

subject: bugbear count
fact: A column of black-clad bugbears from the Greater Temple arrived to summon the new rulers of the Upper Temple.
source_quote: Bugbears. A column of them, and the black they wore was not Earth Temple black — it was the deeper black, the black of the thing below the thing.

subject: summons to the Greater Temple
fact: Barkinar summoned the party to the lower chamber, where Calmer was assumed to be the leader, and the party was given one week to organize the temple.
source_quote: Come down, bring your puppet master if he is alive. We should talk.

subject: Barkinar's chamber
fact: The chamber beneath the Upper Temple is fortified with a hill giant, ogres at the walls, and sealed exits, designed to prevent escape.
source_quote: The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out. A hill giant. Ogres at the walls.

subject: treasury value
fact: The treasury of the Upper Temple is unaccounted for and of interest to the Greater Temple.
source_quote: A treasury unaccounted for.

subject: deadline
fact: The party has one week to organize the Upper Temple before Barkinar returns.
source_quote: A week.

subject: Senshock count
fact: Senshock, the Lord Wizard of the Greater Temple, is ambitious, paranoid, and useful.
source_quote: Senshock — our Lord Wizard — has opinions about new arrivals. He is ambitious and paranoid. He is also useful.

subject: Falrinth count
fact: Falrinth is a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.
source_quote: Falrinth, a wizard hiding from the Greater Temple for reasons of his own.

subject: assassination of Belsornig
fact: Belsornig, Prophet of Water, was killed by Zephyr using Kelno's Dagger of Venom after the party infiltrated his chamber.
source_quote: I crossed the last step, found the soft place under the ribs, and drove Kelno's gift home.

subject: Water Temple inner sanctum
fact: The inner sanctum of the Water Temple was reached silently after the assassination of Belsornig and his guards.
source_quote: We crossed the chamber like the floor owed us silence — and it gave it, every footfall swallowed, not a breath out of place.

subject: seashell offering value
fact: A shallow basin in the Water Temple's altar held coins, gems, and seashells as an offering.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: Air Temple stairs
fact: The stairs leading to the Air Temple were the intended escape route, but were blocked by the arrival of the Greater Temple's bugbears.
source_quote: We turned for the stairs in the Air Temple, meaning to go home...

subject: bluff with Kelno credentials
fact: The party successfully deceived the guards by claiming to be messengers from Kelno bearing news of an assassination.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it.

subject: hill giant count
fact: A hill giant was stationed in Barkinar's chamber as a deterrent to rebellion.
source_quote: A hill giant.

subject: Greater Temple hidden passages
fact: The Greater Temple maintained hidden passages and observers throughout the Upper Temple, unseen until revealed by the bugbears.
source_quote: They had forces on this level, in the parts of the map we had never walked, sitting quiet behind brown marble while we ran our little war for them floor by floor.

subject: bronze gargoyle value
fact: Bronze gargoyles, covered in verdigris, sat atop triangular plinths in the Water Temple's chamber.
source_quote: In each corner a triangular plinth ran up toward the vaulted dark, and atop each one a bronze gargoyle squatted under its coat of green.

subject: false identity assumption
fact: The Greater Temple assumed Calmer was the leader of the party, a misperception the party allowed to persist.
source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.

subject: gong resonance
fact: A deep gong rang after Belsornig’s death, signaling a change in power within the temple.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level.

subject: Water Temple corridor
fact: The corridor of the Water Temple opened into a hall the size of a barracks, with arched ceiling lost in shadow.
source_quote: We came up on the Water Temple and the corridor opened into a hall the size of a barracks, the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: serpentine idol value
fact: A serpentine idol shaped as a writhing knot of fish, eels, and octopi stood in the alcove of the Water Temple.
source_quote: An idol of serpentine stone: a writhing knot of fish and eels and octopi sculpted into one horrid mass.

subject: west door of Water Temple
fact: The west door of the Water Temple was the chosen entry point due to fewer rooms and lower risk.
source_quote: The west door. Always the west door — fewer rooms, fewer surprises, fewer chances for a war zone to introduce me to something it had been saving.

subject: door failure
fact: Zinnia's two attempts to break the west door failed, alerting the guards and forcing a change in strategy.
source_quote: It didn't give. I bounced. The door held and threw me back... Twice. The same flat, jarring nothing, twice.

subject: Barkinar count
fact: Barkinar is the leader of the Greater Temple, who observes, manipulates, and demands order from the Upper Temple.
source_quote: Barkinar brought Calmer with him, half-carried... He gave us the inventory of our new holdings...

subject: Water Temple altar
fact: The altar in the Water Temple's hall held a round, squat basin of water, where offerings were placed.
source_quote: An altar near the middle of the hall, round and squat, its concave top holding a shallow basin of water...

subject: false cleric leadership
fact: The party allowed the Greater Temple to believe Calmer was their leader, using the misperception as tactical cover.
source_quote: Yes, he's hurt. He will be fine.

subject: Greater Temple command chamber
fact: Barkinar's command chamber was located below the Upper Temple, accessible via hidden stairs, and fortified for control.
source_quote: We went down. The room at the bottom was built to remove the question of whether we could fight our way out.

subject: bronze sheet value
fact: A great sheet of bronze, covered in verdigris, was set into the west wall of the Water Temple.
source_quote: A great sheet of bronze set into the west wall.

subject: assassination of Belsornig's guards
fact: Two cult fanatics guarding Belsornig were killed by Sequoia and Zinnia before Zephyr struck the Prophet.
source_quote: Sequoia and Zinnia took the first one apart. The second was mine.

subject: Water Temple entrance alcove
fact: The Water Temple's entrance alcove held the serpentine idol and was the focal point of the offering.
source_quote: South of it, in the mouth of an alcove, an idol of serpentine stone...

subject: bluff acceptance
fact: The guards behind the door accepted the courier bluff because the news of Alrrem’s death and the Obsidian Edge’s threat was credible.
source_quote: They're dead, then, with Alrrem dying, and those fools… All that remains is for us to defeat those pompous asses known as the Obsidian Edge.

subject: Water Temple ceiling
fact: The ceiling of the Water Temple was arched and lost in shadow, contributing to the submerged atmosphere.
source_quote: the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: seaweed drapery value
fact: A seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind the serpentine idol in the Water Temple.
source_quote: with a seaweed drapery hung across the wall behind.

subject: door breach by Zinnia
fact: Zinnia finally breached the west door after two failed attempts, initiating the confrontation.
source_quote: I set myself, and I hit it. It didn't give. I bounced.

subject: ogre count
fact: Ogres were stationed at the walls of Barkinar's chamber as enforcers.
source_quote: Ogres at the walls.

subject: Barkinar's departure
fact: Barkinar left the chamber after issuing orders, without further engagement, signaling his confidence in control.
source_quote: Before any of us spoke, Barkinar turned. He said something quiet to one of his ogres, and walked back down into the dark.

subject: Water Temple hall
fact: The Water Temple's hall was large, with polished blue stone slabs, blue-swirled into deep green, and a soft luminosity.
source_quote: The walls were slabs of polished stone, blue swirled into deep green, and some old magic had been laid into them — a soft, cloudy luminosity...

subject: coins and gems value
fact: Coins and gems were part of the offering placed in the Water Temple's altar basin.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

subject: false messenger identity
fact: The party used the false identity of messengers from Kelno to gain entry to the Water Temple.
source_quote: We were messengers, then — bearing word of an assassination, a letter, a coin to prove it.

subject: Water Temple corridor entrance
fact: The Water Temple corridor opened into a hall, with the ceiling lost in shadow and the walls covered in luminous stone.
source_quote: We came up on the Water Temple and the corridor opened into a hall the size of a barracks, the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: gong signal
fact: The gong that rang after Belsornig's death signaled a shift in power to the Greater Temple.
source_quote: And a gong rang. Deep, enormous, rolling out through the whole second level.

subject: Water Temple altar basin
fact: The altar basin in the Water Temple held a shallow layer of water with coins, gems, and seashells.
source_quote: a shallow basin of water, and at the bottom of the basin — coins, a scatter of gems, seashells.

subject: Zephyr's assassination
fact: Zephyr assassinated the second guard after the first was taken by Sequoia and Zinnia.
source_quote: The second was mine. Surprise, for an assassin, is not an advantage. It is a sentence already finished before the man knows it started.

subject: verdigris-covered bronze value
fact: Bronze in the Water Temple was covered in verdigris, indicating long neglect and symbolic decay.
source_quote: Bronze everywhere, all of it gone to verdigris, that green crust that says nobody has touched this in a long time...

subject: Water Temple alcove
fact: The alcove in the Water Temple held the serpentine idol and was the focal point of the offering.
source_quote: South of it, in the mouth of an alcove, an idol of serpentine stone...

subject: Barkinar's assessment
fact: Barkinar assessed the party's efficiency in eliminating four cult leaders and offered them a week to organize the temple.
source_quote: Romag. Hartsch. Alrrem. Belsornig... four problems gone by sundown. You will forgive me if I'm impressed.

subject: Water Temple ceiling shadow
fact: The ceiling of the Water Temple was lost in shadow, enhancing the feeling of being submerged.
source_quote: the ceiling arched and lost somewhere in the shadow high overhead.

subject: seashell offering value
fact: Seashells were part of the ritual offering in the Water Temple's altar basin.
source_quote: coins, a scatter of gems, seashells. An offering.

source_quote: The cleric is in charge, of course.
